rows.note: Use this for something designed or intended to protect, such as protective equipment or a protective stance.

example.english: This piece of protective equipment offers pretty good protection.
example.traditional: 呢款護具嘅保護性幾高。
example.jyutping: nei1 fun2 wu6 geoi6 ge3 bou2 wu6 sing3 gei2 gou1

rows.note: Use this when someone defensively shields a person they favour, especially from criticism or blame.

example.english: Stop being so protective of him; he should admit it when he makes a mistake.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁護短，佢做錯就要認。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 wu6 dyun2 keoi5 zou6 co3 zau6 jiu3 jing6
